_comment: Which VANILLA item model draws each icon-library sprite (vanilla reads better than our own sprites). A sprite not listed keeps its own dyed picture (no vanilla item fits: cone, cup, drink, machine, pad, pile, shield — the shield's own model is special-rendered — and egg, which the panel colours per creature). Every model named must be a FLAT item model (parent item/generated or item/handheld) on 1.21.4 and 26.2; NativeItemModelsTest reads this file, and tools/gen-carrier-model.py writes the jar's copy from it.
